title: Cardinal Billing Account Renewal Down Payment Base When the Renewal Premium Rises
content:
**Clause.** On a Cardinal Billing Account, the premium the renewal down payment percentage is applied to (the down payment base) depends on how far the renewal full-term premium rose over the expiring full-term premium, which is the full-term premium of the term the account currently bills as last rated: the full-term premium after the change on the latest additional-premium or return-premium transaction of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy effective in that term, or, when that term had no such transaction, the term premium received for that term.

- When the renewal full-term premium is at least 115 percent (1.15 times) of the expiring full-term premium, the down payment base is the expiring full-term premium plus one half (0.5) of the increase.
- When it is at least 105 percent (1.05 times) but under 115 percent, the down payment base is the expiring full-term premium plus three quarters (0.75) of the increase.
- Otherwise the down payment base is the renewal full-term premium itself.

The increase is the renewal full-term premium less the expiring full-term premium. The renewal full-term premium is the term premium received most recently on the account.

## Where the expiring full-term premium is read

| What the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's transaction history shows for the term the account currently bills | Expiring full-term premium |
|---|---|
| One or more additional-premium or return-premium transactions effective in that term | The full-term premium after the change on the latest of them |
| No such transaction effective in that term | The term premium received on the account for that term |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Expiring full-term premium | Renewal full-term premium | Ratio | Down payment base |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1,000.00 | $1,200.00 | 1.20 | $1,000.00 plus one half of $200.00, that is $1,100.00 |
| $1,000.00 | $1,150.00 | 1.15 | $1,000.00 plus one half of $150.00, that is $1,075.00 |
| $1,000.00 | $1,100.00 | 1.10 | $1,000.00 plus three quarters of $100.00, that is $1,075.00 |
| $1,000.00 | $1,050.00 | 1.05 | $1,000.00 plus three quarters of $50.00, that is $1,037.50 |
| $1,000.00 | $1,040.00 | 1.04 | $1,040.00 |

**Hypothetical expiring premium.** A term received at $980.00 that later took an additional-premium change leaving the full-term premium at $1,060.00 has an expiring full-term premium of $1,060.00.
